sections.title: 8. Accreditation and recognition of Electrical Engineering in France**

items: **Accreditation of electrical engineering in France** helps students to know the qualification they will receive and how it relates to further study or employment.

The **Commission des titres d’ingénieur (CTI)** assesses the quality of the French engineering programs entitled to award the *diplôme d’ingénieur* and authorizes the establishments to award the title.
A separate qualification is the three-year bachelor's degree or ** BUT qualification **.
Students are to:
* Check the exact qualification mentioned.
* Check **CTI accreditation** if you are looking for a French engineering diploma specifically.
* Possibility of pursuing a master’s degree or engineering cycle.
* See if there are any requirements for professional recognition in the country where you plan to work.

sections.title: 9. Salary and Job Opportunities in Electrical Engineering in France**

items: * Electrical engineering graduates in France can work in energy, electronics, manufacturing, transportation, building systems and industrial automation.
You need to have the right qualifications, technical skills, experience, language skills and work permit to be eligible for a job.
**Possible career paths include:**
* Electrical design engineer or assistant.
* Mechanic, electrical maintenance.
* Power systems technician or graduate professional.
* Electronics design or test professional.
* Automation and control systems specialist.
* Professional in renewable energy systems.
* Developed embedded systems
* Instrumentation or industrial systems specialist.
* Project Coordinator Electric.
Salary expectations: Salary varies by job, region, employer, qualification and experience.

sections.title: 11. UG in Electrical Engineering in France FAQs**

items: **Q1. Can Indian students pursue undergraduate electrical engineering in France?

Yes. **Indian students can study electrical engineering in France** by applying to eligible bachelor’s, BUT, and engineering school programs if they meet the academic, language and application requirements.
Q2. How many years does an undergraduate electrical engineering degree take in France?

You usually study **three years** for a **bachelor’s degree or BUT in electrical engineering**. The classic **French engineering-school route** typically takes five years of study following high school.
**Q3. Are French electrical engineering courses taught in English?**

Some programs are taught in English, such as **INSA Lyon's bachelor's program on electrical engineering and electrical network infrastructure**. Many traditional electrical engineering courses are taught in French, so check the language of instruction.
Q4. What is the cost of undergraduate electrical engineering in France?

fees depend on qualification and institution The published differentiated fee for bachelor level non-EU students under the rules of the relevant public institution for **2026-2027** is €2,902 per year. There are some programs which have separate fee schedules or exceptions.
